video.title: CATACLYSM — The Black Cat vs The Crimson Demon

camera.vibe: Matrix-level intensity; physics-defying motion; high-speed parallax

bgm.style: Matrix-style fight sequence; crescendo and drop pattern

mix.sidechain: duck BGM by ~3 dB on impact

scenes.title: The Awakening of the Crimson Demon
scenes.description: Wide shot — a towering red-winged demon emerges from the black void, pointillist light rippling across its body like molten glass. The camera tilts up as its roar bends the air.
scenes.motion: shards of light swirl around the demon

scenes.title: The Arrival of the Black Cat
scenes.description: Lightning splits the void, revealing a small black cat standing alone, its fur illuminated by flashes. Sparks crawl along its silhouette.
scenes.motion: camera whip-pan to cat under lightning flash

scenes.title: The Standoff
scenes.description: They lock eyes — the cat’s glow intensifies, the demon’s grin widens. The void hums with vibrating energy.
scenes.motion: push-in dual close-up with shaking lens
scenes.sound: low hum rising to sub-bass pulse

scenes.title: Surge of Power
scenes.description: The cat grows larger, its eyes now twin suns. The demon charges, wings unfurling — lightning and plasma twist into violent spirals.

scenes.title: The Clash of Titans
scenes.description: Lightning erupts from claws and eyes; shockwaves tear through the void. Camera spins 360° as both collide mid-air in blinding fury.
scenes.motion: Matrix-style bullet-time rotation; plasma ripples in slow motion

scenes.title: Silence After Fire
scenes.description: A pure white explosion consumes everything — light particles fade until only black remains. No sound. No subtitles. Just the echo of silence.
